name: Nikoo Homes 8
address: Thanisandra Main Road, Bellahalli, Bengaluru, Karnataka
description: Nikoo Homes 8, branded Bhartiya Garden Enclave, is planned around a network of gardens and shared social spaces. The masterplan includes areas for quiet walks, community gardening, sensory experiences and recreation around the Black Swan Club and pool. Documented home formats range from studios to larger family apartments, including options with an additional study.

content.faqsTitle: Six things to know about Nikoo Homes 8

faqs.question: Where exactly is Nikoo Homes 8 located?
faqs.answer: Thanisandra Main Road, Bellahalli, Bengaluru, Karnataka, 560064. The Google Maps link uses this project and address.

faqs.question: What configurations and sizes are documented?
faqs.answer: Studio, One Bed, One Bed with Study, Two Bed, Two Bed with Study, Three Bed, Three Bed with Study, Four Bed with Staff, Loft. Documented saleable/super built-up plan areas span 501–2506 sq ft. The layout table identifies each area basis and applicable phase.

faqs.question: What is the published starting price?
faqs.answer: ₹93 L–₹2.94 Cr* Onward. The pricing record identifies the source and quoted configuration. Unpriced formats are excluded from the reference range; a current cost sheet is needed for the selected unit. Applicable charges are itemised separately by the source.

faqs.question: What is the status and possession timeline?
faqs.answer: Under construction. Published timeline: 2031 onwards, Phase 1 CP reference. This is a published schedule/status reference, not a fresh contractual handover confirmation.

faqs.question: What are the main amenities?
faqs.answer: Black Swan Club, Swimming pool, Central park, Gymnasium, Children’s play area, Indoor games. 30+ CP-marketed amenities. These are published facilities; confirm which are completed and accessible to your selected phase.

faqs.question: What makes this project worth comparing?
faqs.answer: Bhartiya Garden Enclave branding Community sensory aromatic and woodland landscape areas Black Swan Club and pool in the plan. Aaramv can compare these features with your space needs, budget and daily routes, and help coordinate the next steps through move-in.
